params.body:
Dealers embed their stock through an iframe (`website/{dealer_hash}`). During `artisan down` that iframe showed the platform's maintenance page: the Stocklist Dealer logo and heading, the platform contact address, "deze pagina vernieuwt zichzelf". The visitor there is the dealer's customer on the dealer's site.

**Change.** In `errors/503.blade.php`, one branch on `request()->is('website/*')`: no logo, no brand name, no contact address, the sentence "Het aanbod is even niet beschikbaar. Probeer het straks opnieuw." on the same paper ground and type, the same `<meta http-equiv="refresh">` on the Retry-After and the same small groove, no words about refreshing. Everything else on the page (and every other path) is unchanged.

**Why inside the view and not a second view.** `down --render=errors::503`, the exception handler and the tests all resolve one view; a second view would need a chooser in the middleware or handler and a second `--render` path. One `@if` keeps the `$retry` logic shared. `PreventRequestsDuringMaintenance::$except` is untouched.

**Scope cut on request (cutover imminent).** Dutch only: `WebsiteController` reads the language from the `params` route segment, which is not on the request in a form the 503 middleware can use without parsing it, so the sentence is not translated yet.

**Tests.** `MaintenanceModeTest::test_inside_a_dealer_website_the_maintenance_page_stays_neutral`: `website/<hash>` during maintenance is 503 with the sentence and the refresh meta, without "Stocklist", "contact@", "onderhoud", "vernieuwt" or an `<svg>`; `/login` still shows "Stocklist Dealer is even in onderhoud". R P3-12.1 extended with one sentence.

Screenshot at 390: `.playwright-mcp/503-iframe/embed-390.png` in the worktree.
params.title: The maintenance page inside a dealer's website stays neutral
